games.name: Minigolf
games.howTo: Take turns. Pull back anywhere in your half (or by your ball) and let go. The course turns to face whoever is shooting.
games.handicap: Longer aim guide, and strokes off the score

games.name: Air Hockey
games.howTo: Drag your paddle around your half and hit the puck into the far goal.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, wider goal to shoot at

games.name: Sumo
games.blurb: Push the other wrestler out. Best of 3.
games.howTo: Your wrestler turns slowly. Hold your side of the screen to stop and charge, let go to dash where the arrow points.
games.handicap: Heavier wrestler, a little more room at the edge

games.name: Ping Pong
games.howTo: Slide your paddle along your end. Where the ball hits sets the angle.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, slower ball toward you

games.name: Penalty Shootout
games.blurb: Five kicks each, then sudden death.
games.howTo: Shooter swipes toward the goal: faster is harder, a curved swipe bends the ball. Keeper taps left, middle or right to dive, but dive too early and the shooter sees it.

games.name: Snack Snatch
games.blurb: Most points in 30 seconds. Gold snacks are worth 3.
games.howTo: Tap the left or right of your side to snap that critter at the snacks. A miss makes it dizzy for a moment.

games.name: Snake Duel
games.howTo: Tap your left or right button to turn your snake. Walls and trails crash you. Make the other snake crash first!
games.handicap: Slower snake, turn assist near walls

games.name: Quick Draw
games.blurb: Tap first on DRAW! Best of 5.
games.howTo: Wait for DRAW! and tap your button. Tapping early, or on a fake-out like "Draw a picture!", loses the round.
games.handicap: Opponent's tap counts a little later

games.name: Tank Duel
games.howTo: Push your stick to turn and drive (a little push just turns). Tap FIRE. Shells bounce off blocks, so watch out for your own!
games.handicap: Extra armor: more bonks to knock out

games.name: Sea Battle
games.howTo: Hide your fleet, pass the phone, then take turns firing at the enemy grid.

games.name: Four in a Row
games.blurb: Four in a line. Best of 3.
games.howTo: Tap a column to drop a disc.
games.handicap: Hint glow on winning and blocking moves

games.name: Checkers
games.howTo: Tap a piece, then where it goes. Jumps are compulsory and must be finished. Reach the far row to become a king.
games.handicap: An undo per star, and a hint glow from two stars

games.name: Chop Chop
games.blurb: Last one chopping, or first to 50. Best of 5.
games.howTo: Tap the left or right side of your half to chop from that side. Don't stand under a branch when it comes down!

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
games.howTo: Both pick in secret, then reveal.
